### ❔Why EasySMP?
- It is a plugin full with adventures
- there will be fun updates
- Much customization!
- Easy to use

# 🚀Features:
### Itemblocker:
- add items to the item blocker to prevent players using them!
- Advanced menu system
### Hardcore
- Have a set amount of lives and if you die and have 0 lives you get banned!
- Kill other players to get lives
- Revive players!
### End event
- Have a fun end event!
- Sudden death. If it takes to long sudden death will be enabled and the border will be small!
- A super cool ending.
### Extensions
- Use placeholderAPI to show placeholders [Download](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/)
- Discord webhook for logs in your discord server!
